title: Contribution Déterminée au niveau National 3.0 du Maroc (2026-2035)
organization: Kingdom of Morocco, Ministry of Energy Transition and Sustainable Development
temporal_coverage: NDC 3.0 covers 2026-2035 and reports climate and disaster impacts through 2024, alongside longer-term climate projections.
methodology: NDC compiles national risk and loss evidence and regional adaptation proposals.

title: Plan National Stratégique d’Adaptation (PNSA-2030)
organization: Morocco Ministry of Energy Transition and Sustainable Development, Department of Sustainable Development
temporal_coverage: National plan for 2022-2030; combines observed climate trends, sector risk analysis and proposed adaptation measures.
methodology: Plan assesses national and sector vulnerability and prioritizes adaptation actions.
limitations: French text was translated for paraphrase; listed measures are proposals.

title: Water Scarcity in Morocco: Analysis of Key Water Challenges
temporal_coverage: National model uses a 2016 baseline and medium- to long-run water-supply and crop-yield scenarios.
methodology: GTAP-BIO-W comparative-static model simulates national water and crop-yield shocks.
limitations: Results are modeled, not observed, and provide no named local estimates.

title: Morocco 2000003887: PADERMO Supervision Report February 2026
temporal_coverage: Report dated 5 February 2026 on a supervision mission held 16-29 November 2025; implementation indicators generally reflect 31 October 2025.
methodology: Joint 11-day supervision mission visited project sites and reviewed implementation, targeting and climate risks.
limitations: French-language mission report; status reflects late 2025, not current delivery.
